from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W, hashlib

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    bad = [] if ok else ['REF-MISMATCH']
    if manual:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            if gv != v: bad.append(f"{k}={gv!r} want {v!r}")
    print(f"== {name}: {'OK' if not bad else 'PROBLEM ' + '; '.join(bad)}")
    return got

# overlong header length varint gets minimized: length encoded 2-byte
import struct
def envelope_overlong_length(level, pn, body, width=1):
    num = (pn % 2**(8*width)).to_bytes(width, 'big')
    head = bytes([(0xc0 if level=='I' else 0xe0)|(width-1)]) + b'\0\0\0\1' + bytes([1]) + b'\xaa' + bytes([1]) + b'\xbb'
    if level == 'I': head += W.v(0)
    L = width + len(body)
    head += bytes([0x40 | (L >> 8), L & 0xff])   # overlong 2-byte length
    return head + num + body
